caption:
Every lead that waits has a dollar value attached to it.

The Revenue Calculator takes three inputs: monthly leads, close rate, and average job value. It shows what your pipeline is actually worth, and what slow follow-up costs you every month.

Most service businesses underestimate this number because they never run it.

Studies on lead response time consistently show that contacting a lead within 5 minutes can double your odds of closing it, yet most companies take hours to respond.

Run your own numbers before you guess at next month's revenue.
